conflict: Coach Sue Sylvester takes over the school auditorium during New Directions' reserved rehearsal time right before their regional competition. She orders Santana Lopez—who is both a cheerleader and a choir singer—to help kick Rachel Berry off the stage, forcing Santana to choose between her cheerleading spot and her choir.

relationships.description: Fellow choir singers who constantly trade insults, though both rely on each other's voices to win the competition.
Sworn enemies; Sue mocks Rachel's ambition and tries to sabotage the choir, while Rachel refuses to back down.
Strict cheerleading coach and star flyer; Sue expects Santana to spy on the choir and threatens to cut her from the squad if she defends the singers.
